summary: The complete legal domain contains only the 50 initial pile sizes from 1 through 50, and no legal game can execute more than seven successful moves, so runtime scaling cannot honestly distinguish asymptotic classes.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The public contract restricts n to the inclusive range from 1 through 50.

replacement_checks.evidence: The first seven forced removals total 10 + 9 + 8 + 7 + 6 + 5 + 4 = 49 stones; an eighth move would require 3 additional stones, so every legal input stops after at most seven loop iterations.
cases.json contains an authored expected winner for every legal input n from 1 through 50, including every cumulative-removal transition.
